method: one GPU, torch.inference_mode, one untimed warm-up forward per rung, five timed; peak from reset_peak_memory_stats. OOM recorded as a row.
why_not_the_training_calibration: the existing calibration builds an autograd graph and calls backward, so it overstates inference cost and OOMed at 4096 for the loop arm. Every number here is inference-only.

THE_FINDING_THE_TABLE_FORCES.per_forward: birwkv's per-forward throughput is FLAT across context (16,990 -> 18,017 tok/s from 4K to 64K) where the transformers fall by about half (llama 65.3k -> 32.0k; qwen 68.4k -> 35.2k). Its peak memory grows x2.48 where llama grows x3.90 and qwen x3.74, and its analytic state is CONSTANT at 20.0 MiB where llama's KV cache is 448 -> 7,168 MiB and qwen's 144 -> 2,304 MiB. At 64K that is 20.0 MiB against 7,168 MiB: 358x.
THE_FINDING_THE_TABLE_FORCES.per_answer: but nfe is 100 for the masked-diffusion arm and 1 for every autoregressive baseline, so at 64K the answer-level throughput is 180 tok/s against llama's 31,995 and qwen's 35,156. Producing one answer costs about 175x more forward work in wall-clock terms.
THE_FINDING_THE_TABLE_FORCES.the_honest_shape: a TRADE, not a win: the recurrent arm holds a 358x smaller state and degrades far less with context per forward, and pays for it with a 100-forward answer. Any sentence claiming this model is cheaper in compute must be rewritten; the memory claim stands, the compute claim does not, and the per-forward throughput claim stands only if nfe is named in the same breath.

holes.llada-8b-base: load_failed on all four contexts: 'LLaDAModelLM' object has no attribute 'all_tied_weights_keys', a transformers-version incompatibility. Four rows with the error text, not an abort.
holes.mamba2-2.7b: load_failed on all four contexts: no model_type, so it needs its own loader -- the adapter's own refusal names this case, which is why the message reads 'no modeling code (the BiRWKV release) or no model_type (mamba2)'. Four rows with the error text.
holes.correction: the first version of this record said mamba2 had 'no rows written'. It has four -- all load_failed. The claim was written from the absence of a measurement rather than from reading the artifact, which is the same error this campaign has spent the day characterising.

not_a_measurement: analytic_state_bytes is ARITHMETIC from the configuration, not a measurement, and the adapter says so. GQA/MQA would shrink the transformer side.
